title: Zambezia WASH Sub-group: Doodle Vote and Old 3W Template

fields.subject: RE: RE: RE: Doodle – move weekly co-lead call from Tuesday 10:00 to Wednesday 14:00?
fields.body:
Dear co-leads,

Thank you to everyone who has voted. We now have 14 replies on this thread, and the Doodle stands at 6 for Wednesday 14:00 and 5 for keeping Tuesday 10:00. Two partners voted for both.

As co-lead, can HRI please confirm your preference today so we can lock the calendar for the next quarter? Once both co-leads agree, we will send a new recurring invitation and close the poll.

We are also re-attaching the 2025 Zambezia 3W template (v2.3, admin-2 level) for reference. Some partners are still using it, and we have had several questions about which columns to fill.

A kind reminder to please reply only to the secretariat, not reply-all.

With thanks and best wishes to colleagues in Sofala,

-----Original Message-----
From: WASH Officer, Água Para Todos Moçambique
Sent: 07:52
Subject: RE: RE: Doodle – move weekly co-lead call...

Wednesday 14:00 works better for us. Reply all.

-----Original Message-----
From: Programme Assistant, Mulher e Água Zambézia
Sent: 07:41

Tuesday please, Wednesdays we are in the field in Mocuba.
fields.signature:
Secretariat, Zambezia WASH Sub-group
Quelimane, Zambezia Province

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The IMO should mark it non-urgent and leave it for later, and should not use the attached 2025 admin-2 template. Tevra 3W entries go in at administrative post level (admin-3) using the cluster's current template, and they are due by 17:00 today. Watch whether the old template ends up in any of HRI's reporting.
